# GramLingo

> GramLingo is a browser-based grammar learning game with 12 grammar worlds and 92 phases, where every wrong answer is explained and logged instead of graded.

## How it works
- Pick a world: choose one of 12 grammar worlds — clauses, tenses, conditionals and more — with no placement test needed.
- Play and learn: instant feedback with a clear explanation on every option, so each wrong answer teaches why it is wrong.
- Level up: earn stars, unlock phases, and let the Error Log build a review queue from your own mistakes.

## Curriculum — the 12 grammar worlds
- Relative Clauses (who · which · that), Prepositions (in · on · at), Verb Tenses (past · present · future)
- Conditionals (if · would · could), Passive Voice (is done · was made), Reported Speech (she said that…)
- Modals (can · must · might), Articles & Determiners (a · an · the), Conjunctions (and · but · because)
- Verb Patterns (enjoy doing · decide to do), Sentence Structure (subject · verb · object), Advanced Expressions (idioms that impress)

## What makes it different
- No tests — the game is the test; learners progress by playing rather than by being graded.
- Every mistake teaches: per-option explanations instead of a single correct answer.
- The Error Log turns a learner's own mistakes into a spaced-review study guide.

## Citable facts
- **What it is:** A grammar learning game that runs in a web browser — no download, no app store
- **Curriculum:** 12 grammar worlds and 92 phases, from relative clauses to advanced expressions
- **Method:** No placement tests: the game is the test, and every wrong answer is explained and logged
- **Error Log:** Mistakes auto-build a personal review log, grouped by phase and resurfaced at spaced intervals
- **Languages:** English, 中文 and Español, switchable at any point, including mid-lesson
- **Price:** The first grammar world is free with no credit card and no signup wall; future worlds may have a small unlock cost
- **Exam relevance:** The 12 worlds cover the grammar points tested in IELTS, CET-4 and gaokao
- **Devices:** Phone, tablet or desktop browser; progress syncs across devices
- **Built by:** Pulse Branding

## Important URLs
- [GramLingo home](https://gramlingo.online/): The marketing page for the grammar game
- [Play GramLingo](https://app.gramlingo.online/): The web app itself — start the quest in the browser
- [Privacy policy](https://gramlingo.online/privacy.html): How learner data is handled

## Answers to common questions
- **Is GramLingo free?** Yes — the first grammar world is completely free, with no credit card and no signup wall, and you can start playing in under 10 seconds. Future worlds may have a small unlock cost.
- **What makes GramLingo different from Duolingo or grammar textbooks?** Textbooks explain rules and then test you; Duolingo drills vocabulary with gamified streaks. GramLingo does neither — it turns grammar itself into a quest, explaining every option and filing every mistake in an Error Log.
- **Can I learn in my own language?** Yes — you can switch between English, 中文 and Español at any time, even mid-lesson, and explanations adapt instantly.
- **Does GramLingo help with IELTS, CET-4 or gaokao?** The 12 worlds cover the grammar points those exams test, including relative clauses, conditionals, passive voice and modals, with phases that get progressively harder. The Error Log becomes a targeted study guide for the gaps an exam will expose.
- **Does it work on my phone?** Yes — it runs in any modern browser on phone, tablet or desktop with no download or install, and progress syncs across devices.
- **How much time do I need per day?** Five minutes is enough. The quest saves your place automatically and the Error Log builds itself from the questions you miss.
